description: This file contains the class NamedExpressions responsible for writing named expressions and ranges in an OpenDocument Spreadsheet (ODS) format, particularly converting and exporting named formulas and ranges within a spreadsheet document.

classes.name: NamedExpressions
classes.description: Handles writing named expressions and ranges in an ODS spreadsheet, including converting formulas and address ranges to the appropriate format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the writer with an XMLWriter instance, a Spreadsheet instance, and a Formula converter.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Starts the writing process for named expressions, writing the main element and delegating to writeExpressions.

methods.name: writeExpressions
methods.description: Iterates over defined names and writes each as either a named expression or range based on whether it is a formula.

methods.name: writeNamedFormula
methods.description: Writes a named formula, including its name, expression (converted formula), and base cell address.

methods.name: writeNamedRange
methods.description: Writes a named range, including its name, base cell address, and cell range address.

methods.name: convertAddress
methods.description: Converts a cell address to the appropriate format, potentially including worksheet references, by parsing and reconstructing the address.
